This [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a composition of 5 [[small cubicuboctahedron|small cubicuboctahedra]], in the same [[vertex arrangement]] as the [[compound of five small rhombicuboctahedra|compound of 5 small rhombicuboctahedra]].
